profile.title: Personal Profile & Account Capabilities
profile.subtitle: Manage your identity, profile photo, multi-device security sessions, and personal data rights.
profile.avatarHint: Automatically square-cropped to 320×320 & optimized as WebP (JPG, PNG, WebP up to 5MB).
profile.cap1: Search venues, filter by sport, explore interactive distance maps, and claim approved off-peak deals.
profile.cap2: Inspect live availability grids, lock a 10-minute exclusive hold, and pay deposits directly via VietQR.
profile.cap3: Manage booking passes, download calendar (.ics) invites, reschedule, or cancel under venue refund rules.
profile.cap4: Submit verified post-match reviews; export or permanently anonymize your personal account data (C-06).
profile.ob1: Keep your verified email and mobile phone accurate to receive OTPs, booking passes, and weather notices.
profile.ob2: Include the exact booking code in transfer notes before hold expiration; never share OTP codes.
profile.ob3: Arrive on time and present your booking code at the counter for check-in.
profile.ob4: Cancel or reschedule ahead of policy cutoffs; repeated no-shows may restrict online booking privileges.
profile.requestEmailOtp: Send verification code to new email
profile.emailChangedToast: Email updated and fresh security token issued.
profile.passwordChangedToast: Password updated and older sessions revoked.
profile.marketingConsentLabel: Opt in to discounted slot alerts from venues I have played at (max 1 email/week, instant unsubscribe anytime).
profile.deleteWarning: Your personal data will be permanently anonymized and all sessions revoked. Enter your current password to confirm.
